dropped.item: The survey request is specified in hectares ('how many hectares you'd like surveyed'); the edit says only 'how much you'd like surveyed', so the unit is gone at the booking step

changed.item: Certainty of the maps' benefit increased: the original says the maps 'help you spot areas that need a closer look'; the edit says the maps are 'ready to show you which patches deserve a closer look', implying they identify the problem areas directly

added.item: Delivery method implied as email ('Maps in your inbox'); the original does not say how the maps are delivered
'See how your crops are really doing' adds a slight emphasis on accuracy ('really') not in the original 'clear view'
